verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a global financial SaaS platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents customer-selectable data residency or storage regions. The community post on the company's China and Hong Kong presence concerns staff location and access, not a residency control customers can choose, so it does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
